verdicts.reason: HELD, and both quotes are VERBATIM. I opened §1t113s0§.as (1,344 lines) myself. :110 is exactly `this.§1t5203s0§ = "<font color=\'#000000\'>" + §1t1521s0§.getString(175) + "</font>";` and :111 is the #BBBBBB/getString(960) twin. The three states are real and are where the finding says: :336-343 ratio==0 -> htmlText=§1t5204s0§ (#BBBBBB) and visible=true; :344-347 0<r<1 -> visible=false (no text); :348-359 r>=1 -> :352 `§1t88s0§.instance.§1t1516s0§("Snd_criticalDamage");` then :354-357 htmlText=§1t5203s0§ (#000000) and :358 visible=true. The 'plays once, not per frame' guard is genuinely load-bearing and correctly read: :350 fires only when `!visible || htmlText != §1t5203s0§`, and :354-358 immediately set BOTH, so the guard is false on every later tick. strings.json["175"]='Critical Hit' confirmed in the index. The '0..192 resource' is not asserted from thin air either - I traced it: §1t5205s0§ is called at §1t99s0§.as:256/1208/3169/3325 as `(this.§1t4414s0§,this.§1t4415s0§)` and :249 sets `this.§1t4415s0§ = 8 * 24;` = 192. FRAME CORROBORATION I found myself: reference/frames/session11/crit-focus/t1082.100.png (crop x0-640,y760-1080 of 1920x1080, upscaled 3x LANCZOS) shows a THIRD track directly under the green and blue bars, ~25% filled in white, carrying NO numerals - the middle state, seen. TWO NITS, neither fatal: (a) strings.json has no entry "960" (2,533 entries, ids 0-9010), so the empty-state wording is still unnamed - the finding is right not to name it; (b) the android twin BattleUI.as:259-262 calls this widget `reloadbar`/`crittext`, so 'crit' is the text and 'reload' is the bar.

HELD as an honest, fully-grounded STILL_UNHELD - every element checks out and I could not find the missing artifact either. BattleUI.as:245-249 is verbatim updateHp(hptext/hptextshadow/hpbar.bar.scaleX) and :252-256 updateChi(chitext/chitextshadow/chibar.bar.scaleX). The web twin mapping is exact and STRONGER than the finding claims: the call-order match is corroborated by ARITY - §1t5199s0§(:304, two ints, empty body) = setMax(hp,chi)(:237-239); §1t5200s0§(:308, one int, empty body) = setReloadMax(reload)(:241-243); §1t5201s0§(:312-317) = updateHp; §1t5202s0§(:319-324) = updateChi. 'Nothing in AS3 names a colour' holds: I grepped BattleUI.as - hpbar/chibar/reloadbar appear only at :16/:24/:60 (declarations) and :249/:256/:261 (scaleX); every hex colour in the file (:715-742 #FFFFFF/#FF0000/#00FF00/#00FFFF/#FFCC00/#FF9900/#CCCCCC) is chat-log text, routed to updateChatLog(:771). B-11:7 is quoted accurately word-for-word ('a thin green bar ... NOT the blue HP bar', 'a thick blue bar ... (this is HP)'). REBUILD_READINESS.md:178 really does read 'player HP **20/20**' and really is under the ':174 First-hand crux confirmation (own eyes, not agent-reported)' heading, so the A5 class is correct. I opened all three frames at 3x: Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0 = green 20/20, blue 26/26; t1003.000 = green 14/20, blue 31/31; t1082.100 = green 11/20, blue 31/47 - every number in the finding is right, and I confirmed by pixel sample that no bar's fill colour is derivable from any named symbol. NIT: the finding says 'my three frames' but cites only two frame paths - the third (Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0) reaches it only through REBUILD_READINESS.md:178. I opened it directly and it holds, so this is an under-cite, not an over-claim. I did NOT refute this for incompleteness: it is the calibrated answer, and two committed docs really do contradict each other.

new_findings.text: The player HUD's THIRD row is a single slot that shows EITHER the reload/crit bar OR the 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' banner, never both. Measured at native 1920x1080 on three frames: the row occupies y~1031-1046, x~250-510 in ALL of them. In t1082.100.png that slot is a bar - white fill (~#EBEBEB) from x~250 to x~315 on the same brown empty track (~#311F00) the green and blue bars use - and there is NO 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' text anywhere. In t1003.000.png and Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0.png the identical slot is solid brown track with pale glyphs spelling 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE', and there is no bar fill. This is the visual half of a mechanic the code already states: §1t113s0§.as:334 guards the whole three-state block on `this.§1t5182s0§.visible`, and BattleUI.as:262 reads `this.crittext.visible = percentage >= 1 && this.reloadbar.visible;` - the widget has an explicit visibility flag, and the frames show what fills the gap when it is off.

new_findings.lane_impact: L8 ui-hud: do not lay out a fourth row for the stance-lock banner. It is the same 260x16-ish slot as the reload bar, swapped by one visibility flag. Getting this wrong shifts every element below it (the '150% DAMAGE' buff line sits directly under this row in all three frames).

new_findings.text: The three player-HUD bar fills and their shared empty track are MEASURED, not inferred, from one 1080p frame at native resolution. Sampling t1082.100.png at x=255..275 straight down: bar 1 core y=983 = RGB(0,154,5) ~ #009A05 green; bar 2 core y=1010 = RGB(51,78,227) ~ #334EE3 blue; bar 3 core y=1038 = RGB(236,236,236) ~ #ECECEC near-white. All three ride the SAME empty track, sampled to the right of each fill at y=983/1010/1038, x=440..500: RGB(~49,31,0) ~ #311F00 dark brown. CAVEAT stated up front: this is a lossy 1080p re-encode of an 800x480 native game (REBUILD_READINESS.md:171), so these are within-a-few-units approximations of the OG hues, not the SWF's authored fill values - the SWF shapes under reference/extracted/shapes/ are 1,822 unnamed numbered SVGs with no SymbolClass map, so the authored value is not currently recoverable. Explicitly does NOT bind colour to STAT: it binds colour to POSITION (1st/2nd/3rd track).

new_findings.text: B-11:7's stated REASON for calling the blue bar HP is broken by a frame, though its observation is not. B-11:7 argues the thick blue bar 'is HP — stayed pinned at 47/47 the whole segment, i.e. player took no damage'. reference/frames/session11/crit-focus/t1082.100.png shows a blue bar with the SAME maximum, 47, reading 31/47 - so the max-47 blue bar demonstrably depletes. B-11's within-segment observation survives (blue may well have been pinned across 25:01-27:00); the inference from it does not. Pushing the other way in the same direction: reference/frames/duel_dense/Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0.png reads green 20/20 and blue 26/26, and REBUILD_READINESS.md:178 - Kheshav's own-eyes A5 verdict on that exact frame range - records 'player HP **20/20**'. In that frame the ONLY bar reading 20/20 is the green one, so his HP read lands on GREEN. STANDING INVARIANT, said out loud: B-11 is a measurement doc and Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0 is a frame, and THE FRAME WINS. Filed PARTIAL, not HELD, because this is still a two-artifact join (A5 log line + A1 frame) rather than one artifact naming both a colour and a stat, and because it depends on Kheshav not having transcribed the wrong row. It does not close 'which bar is which'; it does say which side of the contradiction is currently carrying weight.
